title: vella pseudocytisus subsp. glabrata
intro: Vella pseudocytisus subsp. glabrata, commonly known as Spiny Restharrow, is a plant species in the legume family. It is a thorny, perennial shrub that is native to the Mediterranean region and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Spiny Restharrow include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
